$comment: Enterprise admin policy for Turrigan Guard for Enterprise. Push via Chrome/Edge managed policy (3rdparty extension settings). Managed values override anything set locally, so IT controls where audit goes and users cannot change it.

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your Turrigan Guard API, e.g. https://api.turrigan.com/v1/guard. The extension posts events to {apiBaseUrl}/events and polls {apiBaseUrl}/entitlement.

apiKey.description: A guard:ingest-scoped Turrigan API key for this tenant. Sent as the X-API-Key header.

userId.description: Optional user identity to stamp on audit events (e.g. corporate username/UPN).

orgId.description: Optional organisation/tenant identifier to stamp on audit events.
